info.name: Kong Enterprise Admin ACLs Criteria Templates API

params.name: page[size]
params.description: The maximum number of items to include per page. The last page of a collection may include fewer items.

params.name: page[number]
params.description: Determines which page of the entities to retrieve.

params.name: filter
params.description: Filters a collection of criteria templates.

params.name: sort
params.description:
Sorts a collection of criteria templates. Supported sort attributes are:
  - `display_name`
  - `name`

Default sort is `display_name` in ascending order.

items.docs: Returns a paginated collection of criteria templates.
